automationNotes: Doc **Project Workspace**: App Switcher → Personalize → project card → **Settings** → **General** / **Users**. **Project card:** automation prefers **`PERSONALIZE_PROJECT_CARD_CONTAINS`** / **`DAL_PERSONALIZE_PROJECT_SEARCH`**, then substring **Doc Personalize Project**; if none match, it opens the **first** listed card with a `/personalize/projects/` link (console warning). **Stack Connection:** **Connect Stack** is matched by visible label (the control’s accessible name is generic). **Connect Stack** click runs the stack picker with **`DEFAULT_STACK`**; if the button stays disabled (name mismatch / no access), the run **warns and continues** so later doc steps still execute. After editing **Name**/**Description**, flow verifies enabled **Save** and **Reset**, clicks **Reset**. **Users**: **Invite User** — email uses `step.value` or **`PERSONALIZE_INVITE_EMAIL`** → **`CS_INVITE_TEST_EMAIL`** → **`CS_EMAIL`**.
